summary: I implemented every stub in my 36 assigned statsmodels files, including the copula distribution and sampling methods, Pickands derivatives, mixture sampling, empirical likelihood descriptive statistics, process regression, robust norms, linalg and sequence helpers, the diagnostic tests, oneway ANOVA and equivalence, and the prediction results, and filled in missing helpers such as the co2 and interest_inflation loaders, the Rayleigh quotient in sandbox/mle.py, and the sandbox regression log-likelihood helpers. Targeted runs pass for tools sequences and linalg, tsa prediction, distributions mixture, robust norms (13/13), emplike descriptive (17/17), and the co2 and interest_inflation dataset checks, while copula, knockoff, process regression and diagnostic tests are blocked by other builders' files (archimedean.py syntax error, base/model.py missing _check_kwargs, statespace tools import) and oneway passes 7 of 15 with some numeric mismatches; I did not see a full-suite result, so the counts are -1.
